Miles Franklin, My Brilliant Career.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/miles-franklin/my-brilliant-career

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Miles Franklin, author, writer of the introduction, died 1954.
- Henry Lawson, writer of the preface, died 1922.

First publication of the text used: 1901 (SE colophon: 'My Brilliant Career was published in 1901 by Miles Franklin.').

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1901, before 1931, so it is in the United States public domain.
- Country of origin: the facts do not give the country of first publication. The possible countries are the United Kingdom, Ireland, the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, India and South Africa. Each has a term of life + 70 years or less. The last to die was Miles Franklin, in 1954, so the text entered the public domain in each of them on 1 January 2025 at the latest.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."
